spec.input: unmodified v3 raw full unpadded working probabilities stored as float16; original xyxy box and original transform
spec.normal_v3_path: unchanged original function, result values preserved
spec.method: sparse bilinear-logit interval minimax linear program; scipy HiGHS with one solver thread
spec.quantization: float16 round-to-nearest-even cells restricted to representable float32 probabilities; P2 sign-preserving >0.5 correction included
spec.stored_next_half: quantization probability cell starts at float32 nextafter(0.5,+inf); underlying positive-logit preimage has open lower 0, relaxed closed 0 for LP with strict positive-logit postcheck
spec.float32_sigmoid_rounding: expand allowed float32 probability endpoints by their half-ULP round-to-nearest envelopes before logit conversion; not a proof of exact GPU sigmoid implementation preimage
spec.saturated_zero_one: one-sided logit intervals, no invented finite observation or probability clamp
spec.missing_edge_knots: same geometric linear extrapolation as v3, explicitly approximate
spec.rank_rule: unsaturated observation count >= unknowns; full structural column rank; positive nonsingular Gram LU pivots with relative minimum >=1e-12
spec.working_binary_decisions: all fitted observation logits >0 must equal stored probabilities >0.5; otherwise retain v3 fallback
spec.output: float32 sigmoid probabilities, positive-logit >0.5 representation preserved; original box crop
spec.failure_policy: retain original v3 fallback and explicit failure/limit/rank/feasibility diagnostic; no silent successful reconstruction
spec.iou_acceptance_threshold: not decided here; independent original >=0.98 qualification remains required
